sources.detail: All 6 live pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 194-341 KB (r.jina.ai not tried - it is IP-403 on these hosts). Parse bounded to the single <table class="tier-list"> block on each page, with the block count asserted EXACTLY 1 per page before reading; the first <td> of each row is the letter, matched whole-cell against the registered 7-band icyveins scale (S+|S|A+|A|B+|B|C, TBD written as an explicit null), and each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster rather than split at a space. Counts printed and reconciled against 27+7+6=40 BEFORE any merge: raid 27/7/6 and M+ 27/7/6 = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. Upstream still publishes exactly TWO M+ DPS specs as TBD - Windwalker Monk and Frost Death Knight - and both stay explicit nulls, reading '-' and sitting outside the consensus mean. All 80 letters are byte-identical to stored, so NOTHING was merged and specs.json is untouched by this source; only the page snapshots advanced to today. Page self-dates re-read from JSON-LD dateModified and unchanged: raid DPS 2026-08-23T13:09Z, raid healer 2026-08-24T00:44Z, raid tank 2026-08-08T15:00Z, M+ DPS 2026-08-23T15:31Z, M+ healer 2026-08-23T13:48Z, M+ tank 2026-08-23T12:46Z - identical to the stored published values AND to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact, so that cross-check has three agreeing witnesses. Era-verified s2 on all six from the BODY, not the title: the raid HEALER page still titles itself 'Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight' while its body reads 'the various healing specializations for Midnight Season 2' and discusses the Season-2 Abundance rework - body over title, the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified unchanged (s2 on all six), so freeze-season had nothing to consider.

Both pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB. CSS stripped before parsing - the literal string 'tierlist' occurs 25-27 times per page and all but a handful are stylesheet selectors, so anchoring on it without dropping <style> finds rules rather than rows. Letters read from each tier__tier block's tier__title, specs from each entry's img alt. Extra tierlists rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position: the M+ page carries 48 images and the 8 that fail to map are exactly the eight dungeon-difficulty blocks (King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs). 40 rows per bracket, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, letters confined to the registered 4-band method scale S|A|B|C. All 80 letters byte-identical to stored - nothing merged, only snapshots advanced. Page self-dates read from the body's 'Last Updated' line: raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026 (the M+ list is bylined Tactyks). Era-verified s2 from the body: the raid page says 'the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss' and the M+ page 'dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2'; Devourer present in both. Method carries no published field in the registry, so these self-dates are recorded here rather than written into sources.json - adding a field is registry structure, not an agent-updatable value.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried first, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse: unescape backslash-slash across the WHOLE document FIRST, then locate [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] in the unescaped text - never anchored on WH.markup.printHtml(, which is the decoy that once returned 0 rows for the raid-healer page. Exactly ONE tier-list block found per page, asserted. Tier labels matched with tolerant whitespace inside [tier-label ...] and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug, which sidesteps the two-word-class-name split entirely. Counts reconciled before merging: 27/7/6 per bracket = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. ONE letter moved: Holy Priest M+ C -> B. It is corroborated rather than merely parsed - the M+ HEALER page's own dateModified is 2026-08-26T13:33Z, i.e. it rebuilt yesterday and is the ONLY one of the six to have re-dated, while the other five self-date 2026-08-14 (raid DPS, raid tank) and 2026-08-18 (raid healer, M+ DPS, M+ tank), all unchanged from stored and from the pre-agent published-evidence artifact. That rebuilt page's stored published value was ADVANCED 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-26 to match what the page now says about itself; the published gate caught the omission on the first gate run (it cross-checks the stored value against the pre-agent evidence artifact, which independently read 2026-08-26), and the corrected value agrees with both our own fetch and that artifact. A letter moving on the one page that re-dated and nothing moving on the five that did not is the shape of real upstream movement; parser drift would not respect that line. Era-verified s2 on all six from body and title (each self-identifies 'Midnight Season 2'); Devourer present in both DPS pages. seasonVerified unchanged. Bylines were recorded while verifying and are flagged as a NEW firewall finding: raid DPS and raid tank are Dratnos, M+ DPS tettles, M+ healer AutomaticJak, M+ tank YoDaTV - all four are registered creators, and 23 live takes sit in the bracket their author writes. Owner decision per the flag-never-retire rule; nothing was superseded.

Site-wide Cloudflare human-verification wall for a second consecutive night. Every registered page returns HTTP 403 with the 'Just a moment...' interstitial (challenge-platform present, bodies 5.9-6.2 KB) under the full browser header set - the three Heroic raid rankings pages and the M+ DPS page - and so does https://www.archon.gg/wow, the site ROOT, which is not a tier list and has no reason to be gated on its own. A second transport was tried: r.jina.ai returns HTTP 200 carrying a 319-byte 'Human Verification / One Quick Check' page, i.e. the proxy sees the same interstitial rather than the content. Two independent transports plus a probe of the root is what makes 'the site is walled' a measurement rather than an inference about our own parse. Nothing merged, no snapshot bumped, stored letters byte-identical. Standing consequence worth keeping in view: Archon is the only tier source still describing S1 ('updating for 12.1' on every bracket), so this wall is also blocking the one consensus recomposition the anomaly gate is waiting for.

Fetched successfully and DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest, then nothing merged because upstream is frozen. manifest.json snapshotDate reads 2026-08-11 and the rankings file's own Last-Modified header reads Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two AGREE, which is the check the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest incident requires (that day the manifest was stale while the payload had moved, so a frozen snapshotDate is not by itself evidence). Payload parsed: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === 'lowerBound' AND keyRange === undefined (melee and ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would silently double-count 27 specs) gives 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched - classSpec names are byte-identical to the roster. All 40 lowerBound values round-match stored at the series' stored 1-dp precision, so there is genuinely nothing to merge. 16 days frozen; the coverage date correctly does not move. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED standing red recorded on the contract row - upstream, not our fetch - and it clears when WoWMeta re-runs. Not acked away, maxAgeDays not touched.

MERGED 40 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank), all 40 values moved. Plain GET on the three meta pages - r.jina.ai does NOT work on murlok - HTTP 200, 71.3 / 42.3 / 40.9 KB. All three pages self-identify 'Midnight Season 2 ... Patch 12.1' and read 'Updated 51-56 minutes ago', so asOf = 2026-08-27 (the site recuts every 8 hours). PARSER TRAP WORTH RECORDING, because it reproduces the 34-of-40 shape the 08-26 run hit and it is NOT a roster problem: murlok varies its ATTRIBUTE ORDER. Splitting entries on '<a class="vi-box meta-item' returns 25/5/5 = 35 rows with 0 unmatched and no error of any kind, because a few entries per page write '<a href="..." class="vi-box meta-item ...">' instead - on the DPS page the two lost that way are Windwalker Monk and Frost Death Knight. Splitting on the BARE class token 'class="vi-box meta-item' returns 27/7/6 = 40. Only the count reconciliation catches this: dropped rows are silent, and metrics UPSERT, so a short parse would have left stale ceilings standing under a fresh date. After the fix, ranks were additionally asserted contiguous 1..N on each page. Movement is uniform and small - every ceiling rose, largest Demonology Warlock 3200 -> 3307 (3.3%), median about 2.4% - consistent with two days of top-50 rating climb and far under maxValueMovePct 0.6 and maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35. Stored 'rating' unit and integer precision matched exactly.

Fetched all 27 DPS charts at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk, three attempts each, and MERGED NOTHING - the correct outcome for a partial upstream roster, not caution. 19 charts returned real payloads; 8 returned the 76-byte error body on every attempt: Havoc DH, Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, Retribution Paladin, Arms Warrior, Fury Warrior. That persistent set has SHRUNK from the ten recorded on 2026-08-20 - Devourer Demon Hunter and Windwalker Monk now return data. Every one of the 19 carries simc_settings.tier = MID2, read off the chart and never hard-coded, with chart timestamp 2026-08-26; stored is 26 MID1 profiles at 2026-07-08 (Elemental Shaman 2026-07-15). simc_settings.ptr is the string '0' and was compared explicitly rather than truth-tested. Merging is blocked three ways and any one is sufficient: SIM_TIER_REQUIRED plus the tier-uniformity invariant forbid a pool holding both MID1 and MID2; MID2 measured about 1.79x MID1 with a spec- and target-count-dependent ratio, so the pool is not comparable on the scale-invariant percentile axis fightLabels computes, and merging the 19 alone would hand the strong labels to whichever specs happened to be re-simmed; and adopting only the 19 drops 26 -> 19 rows, a 27% drop past maxRowDropPct 0.25. fightProfile.asOf stays each chart's own stored date rather than today, so the coverage date correctly remains 2026-07-08 and the staleness red is the honest signal. FIX PATH: a reviewed local run (or a value_move_ack re-run) adopting MID2 wholesale once the missing specs re-sim - note that bloodmallet and simulationcraft are now blocked on substantially the same specs and would clear together.

Fetched, and this is the most CHANGED source tonight: the standing red's clearing condition is now HALF met and it needs an owner decision. MID1_Raid.txt is now a 272-byte in-progress stub with no 'DPS Ranking:' block, so per the documented fallthrough MID1_Raid.html was fetched instead (37 MB): it reads SimulationCraft 1205-01 for WoW 12.0.7.68974 Live (hotfix 2026-08-06) - the same OLD-PATCH report our stored 2026-08-08 rows came from, i.e. MID1 is a 12.0.7 artefact now rather than a stale 12.1 one. MID2_Raid.txt (1.2 MB) self-identifies '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-26/69497, git build HEAD 32146c2cc6)' - LIVE, not the 12.1.0.69382 PTR header that justified the 2026-08-21 standing red - and it is a COMPLETE run (EndTime 2026-08-27 07:27:17, text and html reports emitted) carrying a real 'DPS Ranking:' block of 38 profiles. BUT it covers only 19 of the 27 DPS specs: mapped by longest-prefix with a hyphen allowed, best-variant-per-spec, the absent 8 are Devourer DH, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms and Fury (four classes missing outright; Augmentation is absent by design, so 7 of the 26 stored rows would be dropped). MERGED NOTHING, measured rather than assumed: MID2 runs about 2x MID1 on the overlap (Assassination 107689 -> 242353, Subtlety 123493 -> 268289, Havoc 116571 -> 241942; overlap median 118762 -> 234644), so (a) every one of the 19 rows exceeds maxValueMovePct 0.6 and these ARE above minValueMagnitude 100, so unlike mythicstats the gate genuinely fires; (b) the family median moves about 98% against maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35; (c) wholesale adoption drops 26 -> 19 rows, 27% past maxRowDropPct 0.25; and (d) merging only the 19 would leave seven 12.0.7 values standing under the same season-agnostic name 'SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS', whose ranks are computed across the pooled family - a mixed pool with no gate of its own to catch it. Per the promoted rule a correction that big is HELD BACK rather than worked around, and the value-move gate has no agent-writable proposal channel by design. Stored rows byte-identical, coverage date stays 2026-08-08. FIX PATH for a human: a value_move_ack re-run or a reviewed local run adopting MID2 WHOLESALE, which also needs a decision on the 7 dropped specs and on whether this metric name should carry its sim tier the way fightProfile.tier now does.

MERGED 40 rows, 36 values changed - and the 2026-08-26 HOLD is now correctly released. /period/latest 302s to /period/1078, the same period last night declined to merge, but it has MATURED: the page reads 'Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (4397 unique), 15.4 average key level' against yesterday's 7671 unique at 10.6, and a unique count falling while average key level rises is the signature of a week settling rather than a day-one sample. 15.4 is now comparable to completed period 1077's 15.3, which is the specific comparability the 08-26 hold was waiting for. Parse BOUNDED to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section, ending at the next heading 'Classes and specs' - the unbounded scan picks up the classes block and the per-dungeon sections and yields far more rows; labels normalised across the lowercase-hyphenated form ('devourer demon-hunter'), value taken from the <span class="mt-1"> that FOLLOWS the bar's height style, never the height itself. 40 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. Shape checks before merging confirm this is the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-presence figure: sum 100.1% with role subtotals matching the page's own group headings exactly - Ranged 31.4 / Melee 28.6 / Tank 20 / Healer 20. CORRECTION TO LAST NIGHT'S ROW, recorded so the next run does not inherit a false constraint: the 08-26 detail gave 'would trip maxValueMovePct' as its mechanism, but checkValueMove skips any row whose previous value is under minValueMagnitude (100), and the code comment names THIS series as the reason that floor exists - every representation value is a low percentage, so it cannot trip. Tonight 7 rows nominally exceed 60% relative movement (Demonology 1.1 -> 3.2, Beast Mastery 0.6 -> 1.5, Frost Mage 0.1 -> 0.0) and all 7 sit below the floor. The 08-26 CALL was still right; only its stated mechanism was wrong. asOf = 2026-08-27, the run date, matching the stored convention for this source. NOT fetched by design: robydoby, whose two sheets are the closed 12.1 PTR raid-testing lane (final receipts, like the zone-52/54/56 rows) and which sits outside required-sources.json deliberately.

Feed +1: a 2026-08-26 kind 'hotfix' entry, 4 specs / 4 highlights. Canonical source read DIRECTLY rather than off the Wowhead mirror - Kaivax's running hotfix blue post, us.forums topic 2336376 fetched as .json by curl so the whole post_stream comes back; its title has rolled to 'World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - August 26' and post 1 was edited 2026-08-27T00:55:19Z to carry the August 26 section. Read with its <ul> heading structure INTACT, which settles the post's one attribution question: the Sudden Death line sits directly under the BARE Warrior heading with no spec beneath it, one level shallower than the four spec-scoped lines, so it is logged 'Warrior (class-wide)' rather than guessed onto Arms or Fury; the class-wide sentinel is in specsAffected, and specBuildChanges was run afterwards to verify Arms, Fury and Protection each receive it flagged classWide while Prot Paladin, Holy Priest and Elemental Shaman each receive their own line. Classification checked rather than assumed: three of four classify null, and Elemental Shaman classifies BUFF (the Farseer fix restores healing Maelstrom Supremacy was failing to increase) - reported as such rather than talked down. It moved no outlook DIRECTION, since Elemental is driven by a dated writeup verdict (Positive, up); only its line counts moved, +2/-1 across 6 builds to +3/-1 across 7, verified by running outlookFor against the committed feed and the new one side by side. ONE CLASS LINE IS DELIBERATELY DEFERRED AND NEEDS A LOCAL RUN: the post's Devourer Demon Hunter line ('Fixed an issue that prevented the effect of the Devourer 2-piece set bonus (Soulburst) from displaying correctly') matches SET_KEYWORD, so logging it obliges bumping that spec's tierSet.asOf/source, and since 2026-08-23 validateData ALSO requires gearing/data/specs.json to carry identical set2/set4/asOf. The nightly structurally cannot ship the gearing half - the refresh artifact path is 'data/' plus the skill logs, and publish stages 'git add data/ dist/ .claude/skills/*/log.md', so gearing/ travels in neither. Measured, not assumed: with the tracker bumped and the mirror at its committed 2026-08-15 text, validateData returns exactly 2 errors, both the tierSetSync message for Devourer Demon Hunter - a Gate-1 red that discards the whole night AND would repeat every night after, since the un-logged hotfix is re-derived each run and the same edit is reached again. Deferring one display-bug line is the smaller, reversible loss; the deferral is written into the build entry's own label as well as here, so it is discoverable from the data. LOCAL-RUN FIX, one pass: append the Devourer line to the 2026-08-26 entry's highlights and 'Devourer Demon Hunter' to its specsAffected; set that spec's tierSet.source to https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/world-of-warcraft-midnight-hotfixes-august-26/2336376 and tierSet.asOf to 2026-08-26 with a dated parenthetical appended to set2 (the 2-piece WORDING is unchanged - the 08-20 Affliction Warlock entry is the precedent); then run 'node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs && npm run gearing:build'. Worth raising as a STRUCTURAL item: any set-touching hotfix now puts the nightly in this position. Three discovery channels swept: Wowhead news RSS (187 KB, 40 items, parsed per <item> block, newest 2026-08-27 08:00), the news INDEX (data.news.newsData brace-balanced from the id attribute, 20 posts, identical head - so nothing landed mid-run), and the blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries) - no new standalone class-tuning blue post and NO 12.2 PTR announcement. The 12.1 development-notes thread 2317811 is still at post #19, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42Z: the closed cycle's expected silence, re-verified, not a lost thread. Correctly NOT logged from the same window: the Coiled Altar / Ula'tek / Nymrissa weekly-reset tuning article and 'Heroic Vashnik Nerfed in Hotfixes' (encounter tuning, no class line) and the Tettles/Ion interview news=382637 (design commentary). Dormant PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) skipped as designed - their contract rows left at the flip. Tier-set upkeep otherwise clean: the Restoration Druid 4-piece 'Genesis duration increased by 8 seconds (was 4)' is already stored at 8 with asOf 2026-08-22 and the gearing mirror agrees.

All 44 transcribable creators polled via youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml - 44 of 44 returned HTTP 200 on the first attempt, zero errors and zero retries, 15 entries each. Every creator entry carries a channelId, so nothing was skipped for the advertised-but-never-polled reason the 2026-08-08 audit found. Seen-set rebuilt from STRUCTURED DATA only (pending-transcripts.json seen[] 549 + skipped[] 413 + videos[] 0, plus every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url) = union 1204; log.md was not regexed. Cycle bound derived as min(builds[].date) = 2026-06-18, taken as a DATE and not an index - the feed is newest-first, so builds[0] is tonight's 08-26 hotfix and using it would cut the sweep to nothing. Result: 194 unseen videos on or after the bound, of which 130 pass the class/spec/12.1/Season keyword filter. This is a NIGHTLY, so the keyword filter STAYS - Supadata's free tier is 100 requests per MONTH and it is the 27th, so breadth belongs in a local run. QUEUED 3 (videos[] 0 -> 3; the deterministic transcript step ran before this agent with an empty queue and verdict 'ok', so these drain tomorrow), each settled with media:description alongside the title at zero transcript cost: A7ZMRYQALHw Kalamazi 08-26 'Is Demo OP? Warlock Buffs Are Changing Things!' (description 'These buffs might have been a bit bigger than we think' - an explicit spec-strength read on the 08-25 Warlock pass, and he is scoped to all three Warlock specs); inGFY23zA-c Critcake 08-26 'FURY IS UNDERRATED. +17 Den of Nalorakk' (description 'Very curious how Arms and Fury will compare in keys when I get the new 4 set' - a comparative claim between the two specs he is scoped to, not a routine key POV); and wgwLOufz5r8 AutomaticJak 08-27 'RWF Healer Comp Explained' (cross-healer comparative analysis, and RAID-framed, which matters given the firewall finding below). NOTHING was distilled, so no take, metaNote or creator 'latest' field was written - takes stays 553, metaNotes 374, newest 2026-08-25. Only Tactyks/Method has ever been recorded that way. Measured exposure in the current take set: 23 live takes sit in the bracket their author writes (Dratnos 3, tettles 4, AutomaticJak 7, YoDaTV 9). Per the standing flag-never-retire rule nothing was superseded or narrowed. Icy Veins' pages are bylined 'Petko', not a registered creator, so that source is clean.
